    As of April 13, 2026, the Indiana Fever have built a 2026 roster around cornerstones Caitlin Clark, Aliyah Boston, and Kelsey Mitchell, who signed a supermax extension. The team has added veterans, including Sophie Cunningham, Lexie Hull, Damiris Dantas, and Myisha Hines-Allen, alongside 2026 draft picks Raven Johnson (No. 10) and Justine Pissott. 
    2026 Indiana Fever Roster (As of April 13, 2026) 
    • Guards: Caitlin Clark, Kelsey Mitchell, Sophie Cunningham, Lexie Hull, Ty Harris, Raven Johnson, Megan McConnell (Training Camp), Kayana Traylor (Training Camp)
    • Forwards/Centers: Aliyah Boston, Damiris Dantas, Myisha Hines-Allen, Makayla Timpson, Monique Billings
    • Key Re-signings/Additions: Kelsey Mitchell (Supermax), Sophie Cunningham, Lexie Hull, Myisha Hines-Allen, Damiris Dantas
    • 2026 Draft Class: Raven Johnson (No. 10), Justine Pissott (No. 25), Jessica Timmons (No. 40) 
    The Fever focused on retaining core talent and adding depth following an expansion draft. Head coach Stephanie White highlighted the addition of guard Raven Johnson to the backcourt.
